proposal.root_cause: Carrier validation rule changes cause shipment notices to be rejected due to LOC_UNKNOWN and EVENT_ORDER reasons.

remedies.description: Establish a carrier‑shipper change‑management agreement requiring the carrier to publish validation‑rule updates at least 24 h before they take effect and the shipper to automatically incorporate those updates into its notice‑generation process.
remedies.feasibility_rationale: Can be drafted and agreed within the remaining 3.75 h using existing communication channels; no new tooling or budget needed.
remedies.residual_gap: If the carrier fails to provide timely notice, a window of risk remains until the shipper updates its process.
